description: The GRIPE pilot was proposed by Paramount Resources in 2004 to recover shut-in gas over bitumen at Surmont. It tests injection of exhaust gas while producing remaining gas and maintaining reservoir pressure. Descriptors identify annual reports for 2005–2010, a 2011 final report and appendix archives. This is a documented engineering experiment information collection. Neither numerical production/pressure tables nor executable simulation code are established by the metadata. The producer is a non-government entity and the portal states no licence. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The licence and reuse terms are not stated. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
